adverse: Spread max(cell p90,cell mean+2.5*SE of date means); max current commission; per-side slippage0.5*spread plus2x1s volatility proxy. SE is descriptive, not certified coverage.
amplitude: All group development absolute forward moves, quantiles and fraction exceeding each economic cost scenario; descriptive amplitude is not predictability and never chooses a winning instrument/timeframe.
authority: docs/OWNER_SPEC.md v2.0; OWNER explicit statistical historical-cost policy after PR53
boundaryPolicy: Forecasts retained; no exploratory entry when its predetermined horizon exits the known phase calendar. This uses no future source availability or prices. Missing in-phase forward paths remain unknown. Predetermined weekend exit clocks do not create economic proposals on these fixed FX/gold/index CFD roles; all weeks and all predictive forecasts remain in the report.
calendarPolicy: 52 predeclared weeks:26 development/13 selection/13 exposed chronological audit; globally exposed, NOT independent confirmation or12 calendar months.
central: Cell mean spread/commission; per-side slippage0.25*spread plus one diffusion-scaled1s volatility proxy. Not measured fills or latency.
conversion: Conservative current route debit/credit wedge charged on abs(gross)+other modeled friction, using the maximum observed development/current-term conversion wedge. Proxy bps remain in quote-return coordinates, not historical EUR performance.
costCells: Instrument x UTC8-hour block x high/low trailing32 M5 volatility, split at instrument development cost-sample median. Require>=4 samples and>=3 dates, else hour cell then instrument global fallback. No return-based cost fitting.
costModel: CONDITIONAL_COST_MODEL. Reconstruct first valid causal real route-local BID/ASK in every original fixed development cost window; separate spread from current-tariff commission and financing. One sample/window, not thousands of independent ticks.
distinction: New causal prequential generative mixture on raw conserved bars, no calls/imports to BDP1 cells, AIP1 opening ridge, SQP1 binary transitions or other closed forecasts. Old exact recipes/filters/results remain untouched; predictive classes are not globally prohibited.
economicPremises: Persistent latent drift can represent gradual information diffusion or gradual risk-premium repricing; its forecasts must beat a zero-drift predictive baseline after costs.
Temporary deviation from a slowly changing reference can represent inventory/liquidity concessions; reversion is a falsifiable latent-state hypothesis, not observed dealer inventory.
A likelihood-updated mixture with a zero-drift skeptic may adapt between persistent and transitory pricing without picking the best realised-profit model retrospectively.
featurePolicy: Only completed bars; activity is tick count. State evolves on observed bars, preserving observed gaps; previous one-step likelihood updates only for contiguous observations. Never impute bars. Exact future target close may label a terminal return despite intermediate missing bars, which remain a separately disclosed unknown risk path. Missing exact targets remain unknown and cannot cancel earlier forecasts.
financing: Current normal-account daily PIPS/PERCENTAGE supported; ignore credits, apply3x observed directional daily debit at each current-schedule charge crossing. All scenarios disclose this conservative current-term assumption. Missing daily units/schedule blocks cost-admission rather than treating carry as zero.
followupRule: Only PRIMARY_ALL groups with>=30 known selection proposals,>=8 active selection weeks, zero missing active outcomes and positive adverse-cost weekly HAC90% descriptive lower proxy may support a new common-capital execution-priced followup. Selection only; no audit winner selection. This is NOT multiple-testing qualification, independent edge or trading admission. All ablations descriptive on same forecast clocks.
portfolioPolicy: One existing native orchestrator/ledger/session preserved. Proxy groups are not separate EUR200 accounts, may not be summed into financed NET, and do not count toward HARD21. Funded followup needs explicit joint horizon, actual/current-or-modeled FX/margin/risk and one continuous EUR200 book, not the sum of standalone proxy outcomes.
predictiveAndEconomicPolicy: Study every causal forecast without2-SE prefilter. For each cost case, an exploratory proposal exists only if abs(mixture conditional expected bps)>that declared total friction. This is a model decision, not preproof of profit. Nonoverlap within each group; all candidates/variants/cases retained. No funded EUR claims from standalone bps proxies.
sourceExposure: Existing exposed source reused for a NEW predeclared hypothesis. Never independent because downloaded again or model-local unused.
spreadAccounting: BID-close return proxy: long pays modeled entry spread, short modeled exit spread; common predecision distribution for both. One spread plus separate two-side slippage and commissions, no duplicate spread. No fabricated historical ASK quotes/fills.
stress: Spread2*instrument maximum observed development spread plus2.5*date-mean SE;2*maximum current commission; per-side slippage1*spread plus3x1s volatility proxy. Explicit scenario, not future bound.
